findingDetails.title: Quoted doctor-command text bypasses skill-first ordering
findingDetails.evidence: The raw '/doctor:' substring guard preserves the scored ranking, while explicit-author evidence accepts the slash-command marker. The changelog's no-route-changes claim is therefore too broad.
findingDetails.case: A prompt that quotes /doctor:setup can keep the doctor bridge ahead of a passing matching skill.
findingDetails.recommendation: Distinguish direct slash-command invocation from quoted references before bypassing skill-first ordering.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The scorer and release claim are in the steer's advisor-code and changelog scope.

findingDetails.title: Generic check wording advertises setup on unrelated no-match prompts
findingDetails.evidence: SETUP_WORDING accepts standalone check inflections and the no-match renderer adds the setup hint when that predicate is true.
findingDetails.case: If 'Check what time the tide turns' gets no advisor recommendation, it receives a /doctor:setup hint despite being unrelated to tooling setup or health.
findingDetails.recommendation: Require setup, environment, installation, or tooling-health context in addition to a generic check verb.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The predicate and no-match call path are in the steer's advisor-code scope; the advisor changelog says unrelated prompts get no hint.

findingDetails.title: Doctor phrase reach can report stale scorer behavior as current
findingDetails.evidence: The probe checks only that BUILT_SCORER exists before importing the built scorer; it has no source/build freshness comparison.
findingDetails.case: After source changes break a doctor phrase, an older but present dist scorer can still report reach as passing.
findingDetails.recommendation: Check source/build freshness or mark the probe indeterminate when the artifact is stale.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The phrase reach script is in the command scope and is rechecked here against its source.

findingDetails.title: Doctor-routing scenarios omit their required feature-catalog backlink
findingDetails.evidence: The authoring contract requires linking each scenario to its matching feature-catalog entry; DOC-385 through DOC-391 omit that link.
findingDetails.case: A reader opening a scenario cannot follow it directly to the feature contract and its test anchors.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All seven scenarios and the playbook authoring contract were checked.

findingDetails.title: The feature catalog lists an OpenCode hook capability without a feature page
findingDetails.evidence: The root catalog lists native OpenCode hooks and the prompt-wrapper fallback but labels the feature page missing.
findingDetails.case: A reader following this capability has no per-feature implementation and validation anchors.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the feature page or merge/remove the row if it is not a distinct capability.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The catalog row and one-leaf-per-entry authoring rule are in scope.

findingDetails.title: Root README understates the command catalog by two entries
findingDetails.evidence: The README reports 37 commands; the canonical command-catalog checker reports 39 and the command index lists 39/39.
findingDetails.case: Readers sizing the command surface from the root README receive a count two below the canonical inventory.
findingDetails.recommendation: Update both README totals and the group breakdown, or explain the excluded entries.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The checker output and command index reconcile to 39.

findingDetails.title: DOC-391's write-free claim misses a socket-directory creation
findingDetails.evidence: DOC-391 invokes the CLI shim at line 56. skill-advisor.cjs calls ensureSocketDir at module startup (line 102), and ensureSocketDir uses mkdirSync on the default /tmp/system-skill-advisor path when that directory is absent (lines 85-91).
findingDetails.case: On a machine without the default socket directory, /doctor:setup creates it before the warm-only probe returns. DOC-391's git-status comparison does not observe this write. The warm-only path does not cold-start the daemon or write a lease.
findingDetails.recommendation: Document and assert the temporary directory effect, or make socket-directory setup conditional on a mode that may start/attach the daemon.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The in-scope doctor workflow calls the shim, and direct source inspection confirms the top-level directory creation even though warm-only suppresses a cold daemon spawn.

findingDetails.title: DOC-391 calls the setup run write-free while its advisor leg writes daemon state
findingDetails.evidence: The prior interpretation relied on the shared CLI reference, but the runtime implementation prevents warm-only from starting an unavailable daemon.
findingDetails.case: A cold warm-only advisor call returns retryable without spawning the daemon, so the recorded lease-database write case does not occur.
findingDetails.recommendation: Resolve this cold-start claim and retain the separately evidenced socket-directory write as P2-008.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The source was re-read in iteration 5 and contradicts the prior contract-based inference.

searchActions.result: The shim creates its default socket directory before invoking the CLI; the scenario's git status comparison misses the /tmp creation.

searchLedger.rationale: The documented write-free guarantee is false when the default socket directory does not already exist.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The changelog's compatibility guarantee may not hold for quoted slash-command references.

searchActions.queryOrPath: matching-skill order when a prompt contains quoted /doctor: text
searchActions.result: The substring guard preserves doctor-first scoring on quoted references, reconfirming P2-001.

searchLedger.rationale: The implementation uses substring presence as an invocation proxy, so the compatibility statement is too broad.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A warm-only advisor call may cold-start the daemon before checking status.

searchActions.queryOrPath: warm-only flag from CLI entry through ensureDaemonReady

searchLedger.rationale: The previous cold-start interpretation is contradicted by the executable path.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: warm-only suppresses daemon spawning when the daemon is unavailable.
